title: MT61306: Mechanical Processing Of Steels
text:
Syllabus
Syllabus mentioned in ERP

Terminologies related to forming and background concepts; Fundamentals of metal
working. Generalised description of forming processes. Forming operations for
long products. Forming operations for sheet products. Defects in formed steel
products. Controls in forming operations. Effect of forming on property
evolution. Computer simulations related to forming operations
